{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overconfidence in upward moves.",
    "Apply a lag correction: if true outcome is significantly higher than forecast, reduce next period’s forecast by 5–10% to avoid overshoot.",
    "When history shows strong upward momentum (e.g., >65.00 over last 7 days), reduce forecast peak by 5–15% to prevent overreaction.",
    "If forecast consistently underestimates true values (e.g., error > 3.00 over 30d), apply a bias correction: add 0.5–1.0 to forecast mean.",
    "For sentiment = 0.25, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0 to reflect bullish sentiment, but cap at 10% above recent high.",
    "Mean-reversion rule: if forecast deviates > 2.0 from 30d average, adjust toward historical mean by 0.3–0.7 per day.",
    "Avoid forecasting spikes > 10% above recent 7-day high — cap at 8% to prevent volatility overestimation."
  ]
}
